facts.t: Appears in 1.96% of the 23,531 paintings in our archive (461 paintings, as photographed; the within-painting lens finds it in 229).

Peaks in the 1900s: found in 1.6% of the 1,551 paintings we have from then (25 paintings). Against the same museums' baseline that is 1.5x the expected rate.
Inside a painting it most often plays a hidden color (39% of the 229 paintings, by lightness rank within each painting, so varnish cannot fake it).
